Q: How do I track my order?
A: You can track your order in real time under "My Orders > Track Order" using the tracking ID emailed to you at dispatch.

Q: My order is delayed, what should I do?
A: Delays are usually shown with an updated ETA on the tracking page; if it's overdue by more than 2 days, contact shipping support with your order ID.

Q: I received a damaged item, what now?
A: Please report it within 48 hours of delivery via "My Orders > Report Issue" with photos, and we'll arrange a free replacement or refund.

Q: Can I change my delivery address after placing the order?
A: Address changes are possible only before the order is dispatched; please contact support immediately after placing the order.

Q: How do I schedule a return pickup?
A: Initiate a return from "My Orders > Return Item" and select a pickup slot; our courier partner will collect the item from your address.

Q: Do you offer international shipping, and which countries do you cover?
A: Yes — we currently ship to over 40 countries across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, confirmed automatically at checkout based on your delivery address. We do not ship to extremely remote or restricted locations, such as polar research stations, active conflict zones, or countries under international shipping sanctions. If a destination isn't accepted at checkout, it's outside our current serviceable network rather than a temporary issue.

Q: What should I do if my order shows "delivered" but I haven't received it?
A: Please check with neighbors/building security first, then report it within 24 hours via "My Orders > Report Issue" for investigation.

Q: Can I choose a specific delivery time slot?
A: Time-slot delivery is available in select cities for an additional fee, shown as an option at checkout.

Q: How much does standard shipping cost?
A: Standard shipping is free above a minimum order value; otherwise a flat shipping fee applies, shown at checkout.

Q: My package was returned to sender, why did that happen?
A: This usually happens due to an incorrect address, unavailability during delivery attempts, or refusal at the door; our team will contact you to reschedule.

Q: Can I reschedule a delivery?
A: Yes, use "My Orders > Reschedule Delivery" to pick a new delivery date before the next delivery attempt.

Q: How many delivery attempts are made before an order is returned?
A: Our courier partners make up to 3 delivery attempts before returning the order to the warehouse.

Q: Can I cancel my order before it ships?
A: Yes, orders can be cancelled free of charge any time before they're marked "shipped" under "My Orders > Order Details > Cancel Order." Once an order has shipped, you'll need to use our standard return process instead.

Q: Do you deliver to PO boxes?
A: We can deliver small parcels sent via standard postal courier to PO boxes, but larger items requiring a courier signature cannot be delivered to a PO box — this is flagged automatically at checkout if it applies to your order.

Q: Will my order arrive in one package or multiple shipments?
A: Orders with items from different warehouses may ship as separate shipments, each with its own tracking ID; all shipment statuses for one order appear together under "My Orders > Track Order."

Q: Are deliveries slower during sales or holiday periods?
A: Yes, delivery can take 1-3 extra days during major sale events and public holidays due to higher courier volumes; any such delay is reflected directly in your tracking page's updated estimated delivery date.
